title: Graceful Shutdown & Signal Handling
description: Adds built‑in handling for SIGINT, SIGTERM and unhandled promise rejections, ensuring all active connections are closed and pending middleware completes before the process exits. This prevents data loss and improves reliability in production environments.
testCases: Simulate SIGTERM while a request is in flight and verify the server stops accepting new connections but finishes the ongoing request before exiting
Trigger an unhandled promise rejection and ensure the shutdown sequence logs the error and exits with a non‑zero code
acceptance: When the process receives SIGINT or SIGTERM, the framework stops accepting new requests, waits up to 30 seconds for active requests to finish, then closes the HTTP server and exits with code 0. Unhandled promise rejections are caught, logged, and trigger the same graceful shutdown with exit code 1. All tests pass and no resource leaks are detected.
reason: Production deployments need reliable termination to avoid corrupt state, dropped requests, and resource leaks. Providing first‑class graceful shutdown makes yantraverse ready for container orchestration platforms and improves overall stability.
